## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 1v1 soccer game for phones and tablets: the player attacks and defends against a bot, with dribbling, shooting, and curve shots; goals have no goalkeeper.

## Requirements
- User requested a “1vs1 3d soccer game” and described it as a “2D Game (Phone/Tablet).”
- Deliver a playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them upon completion.

## Decisions
- Implemented a responsive, top-down 2D canvas soccer game, treating the explicit “2D Game” direction as controlling.
- Match rules: first to 5 or highest score after 90 seconds; empty goals; touch joystick/actions plus keyboard controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game interface, responsive styling, canvas gameplay, bot AI, scoring, match timer, pause/rematch flows, touch controls, keyboard controls, shot charging, curve shots, dash, and optional sound.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Started a local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Opened `http://localhost:3002` in Playwright and saved/read a screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/soccer-latest.jpg`.

### Active
- Fix a CSS loading/parsing issue discovered during browser verification: `style.css` is being served, but only its first eight CSS rules are parsed; rules from `.topbar` onward are missing. Thus the start modal renders as normal page flow rather than a centered overlay, and other styling is absent.
- Recheck browser rendering and gameplay after fixing the stylesheet.

### Blocked
- Browser check is currently blocked by the malformed/unparsed stylesheet; the exact cause is not yet identified.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `style.css` around the transition between `.vignette` and `.topbar`; fix parsing so all rules are applied.
2. Reload the browser and verify the start screen and responsive game presentation; save/read a fresh JPEG screenshot.
3. Test starting a match and basic keyboard/touch gameplay; address any errors found.
4. Report the 2D interpretation briefly in the completion note.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: game UI, score, menus, pause, touch-control markup.
- `style.css`: responsive layout and visual styling; currently not fully parsing in the browser.
- `game.js`: canvas rendering, soccer physics, bot behavior, input, scoring, match flow.

## Important Context
- Playwright browser is open at `http://localhost:3002`; screenshot checked at `/tmp/opencode/soccer-latest.jpg`.
- Browser inspection showed `document.styleSheets[0].cssRules.length === 8`; only rules through `.vignette` were present, while `.modal` computed as `position: static`, despite its CSS being present in `style.css`.
- Browser console showed one 404 for `/favicon.ico`; no JavaScript errors were reported.
